clips.title: The story
paras: Threat from Below is a Horde bounty tasking adventurers with hunting down a dangerous sea giant prowling Durotar's north coast. Overcoming such an enormous coastal titan protects the nearby shores and earns the respect of the warriors of Durotar.

Along the northern coastline of Durotar, the waters of the Great Sea wash against jagged sands and rocky shores. While typically frequented by simple scavengers and crabs, the northern coast harbors a far deadlier menace: a hulking sea giant roaming the shallows, threatening anyone attempting to travel or secure the waters bordering the Horde's arid new homeland.

Sea giants are towering brutes capable of shattering longboats and crushing warriors beneath massive fists. Slaying one is no ordinary feat for young adventurers, and bringing down this behemoth of the waves earns deep respect among the orcs, celebrated with the traditional war cry of 'blood and thunder' echoing across the dry red bluffs.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: One of my scouts has reported a sea giant followed those naga down here. Not sure if they brought him intentionally or what, but he's dangerous in any case.
It's a young one, but it could still rip a traveler in half in a heartbeat if they were caught off guard. I need him gone. But I'd suggest you find some help to deal with it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ha! I could hear his body fall from here!
Be proud of your kill today; not many can claim they survived a fight with a sea giant.
